notes.title: Full Bug Fixes for All Languages in the EA Version
notes.notes:
Full Bug Fixes for All Languages in the EA Version

Full Bug Fixes for All Languages in the Demo Version

Since the developer's native language is Simplified Chinese, most game testing was conducted in a Simplified Chinese environment.
Testing for other languages was comparatively less frequent.
However, everything is fine now!
A few days ago, the developer created a full-text bug-fixing assistant tool.
It uncovered several bugs in language environments other than Simplified Chinese.
They have now been completely fixed!
No more worries about getting stuck during dialogues!
You can enjoy playing the game in any language environment!

Additionally, this bug fix is a synchronized update for both the EA and Demo versions. Save files from the Demo version can be perfectly transferred to the EA version.
However, if you are already running the EA version, DO NOT load saves from the Demo version, as some progress will be wiped, and certain stages will need to be replayed.
